flow.name: fwod88

steps.instruction: In this Odoo 17 backend, create a new Quotation in the Sales app for the customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (the customer field is an autocomplete dropdown — you must actually select the matching option from the dropdown, not just type the name). Add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue (again the product field is an autocomplete dropdown — select an actual option from the dropdown), with quantity 3. Save the quotation. Then report: (a) the product name you chose, (b) the unit price the app filled in on that line, (c) the untaxed amount the app computed (Untaxed Amount in the totals section), and (d) the quotation's name/reference shown in the breadcrumb or title bar. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state.

Open the existing quotation {{03-create.quotation_reference}} (reference {{03-create.quotation_reference}}, for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer') in this Odoo 17 Sales app — you can navigate to Sales > Orders > Quotations and search for {{03-create.quotation_reference}}, or open {{03-create.url}} . Add a SECOND order line: a product DIFFERENT from 'Acoustic Bloc Screens' (the product field is an autocomplete dropdown — select an actual option from the dropdown), with quantity 2. Save. Then report: (a) the product name of the new second line, (b) its unit price, (c) the new Untaxed Amount shown in the totals section, and (d) both order lines' product names and quantities as shown on the saved form. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state.

reportTemplate.summary: Created the quotation in the Sales app: opened the new quotation form, typed "{{v2}}" in the Customer autocomplete and clicked the real option "{{v1}}" (dropdown closed, Internal link rendered — a record was chosen, not just typed). Added one order line via "Add a product", typed "a" in the product autocomplete and selected the actual option "[FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens", set Quantity to 3, and clicked Save. The save navigated to sale.order id=21 (URL above) with the breadcrumb/title showing "S00021". Read back from the saved form: product "[FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens", Quantity 3.00, Unit Price 295.00, line subtotal £885.00, and the totals section shows Untaxed Amount £885.00 (20% tax £177.00, Total £1,062.00); status "Quotation".
